post.originalText:
Opus 5.5 vs GPT 6.1 Sol

I asked both to build a whale breaching at sunrise in Three.js, each capped at $2.

In my opinion, Opus 5.5 won this one, and I’m loving it.

Same budget, but Opus finished in ~7 mins and Sol took ~10 mins.

Sol’s leap is bigger and splashier, but Opus feels more cinematic to me.
